Remarks

This static class contains helper methods for drawing pixels, arrows, and visualizing collision points using Raylib.

Methods

CalculateArrowPoints(Vector2, Vector2, float, float)

Calculates the geometric points for drawing an arrow with a fixed head width and length.

public static (Segment tail, Triangle head) CalculateArrowPoints(Vector2 tailPoint, Vector2 headPoint, float headWidth, float headLength)

Parameters

tailPoint Vector2

The starting point of the arrow (tail).

headPoint Vector2

The end point of the arrow (head).

headWidth float

The width of the arrow head.

headLength float

The length of the arrow head.

Returns

(Segment tail, Triangle head)

A tuple containing:

  • The tail segment of the arrow.
  • The triangle representing the arrow head.

Remarks

Returns empty shapes if parameters are invalid.

Draw(IntersectionPoints, float, ColorRgba, ColorRgba, float)

Draws intersection points and their normals for a set of collision points.

public static void Draw(this IntersectionPoints colPoints, float lineThickness, ColorRgba intersectColorRgba, ColorRgba normalColorRgba, float pointSmoothness = 0.5)

Parameters

colPoints IntersectionPoints

The collection of collision points to draw.

lineThickness float

The thickness of the lines and circles drawn.

intersectColorRgba ColorRgba

The color used for intersection points.

normalColorRgba ColorRgba

The color used for normal vectors.

pointSmoothness float

Remarks

Each intersection point is visualized as a small circle, and its normal is drawn as a line.

DrawArrow(Vector2, Vector2, float, float, LineDrawingInfo, ColorRgba)

Draws an arrow from the tail point to the head point with a fixed head width and length.

public static void DrawArrow(Vector2 tailPoint, Vector2 headPoint, float headWidth, float headLength, LineDrawingInfo info, ColorRgba headFillColor)

Parameters

tailPoint Vector2

The starting point of the arrow (tail).

headPoint Vector2

The end point of the arrow (head).

headWidth float

The width of the arrow head.

headLength float

The length of the arrow head.

info LineDrawingInfo

Drawing information for the arrow's tail (line color, thickness, etc.).

headFillColor ColorRgba

The fill color of the arrow head.

Remarks

The arrow's tail is drawn as a line, and the head as a filled triangle.
